claim: Selecting a folder imports the selected files plus files in its nested subdirectories, through the existing platform picker and permission path, on desktop and Android.

verification.detail: Android DocumentsUI journey imported three selected files plus two nested files under the selected Footage grant, then passed preview, captions, relink, export, recovery and descriptor/resource checks.

limitations: Android evidence is from an emulator; emulator evidence does not establish physical-device performance or responsiveness.
A prior Android run timed out before reaching the import gateway and passed on rerun; that cause is still unlocalized.
Large-library cache behaviour and broader offline-media/bulk-relink workflows were not covered.
